label: YS-26
title: New phUSD minter deployed without pauser: emergency pause capability absent from birth and never registered with the global Pauser contract
description: PhusdStableMinter implements IPausable with a pauser role (pauser state variable, setPauser, pause, unpause). The constructor sets pauser to address(0). DeployNewPhusdMinter.s.sol deploys the minter and wires it (setClient, registerStablecoin, approveYS, setMaxMintPerDay, IFlax.setMinter) across lines 159-192 but never calls minter.setPauser(...). The downstream Phase 3 script (CutoverAndRevokeOldMinter.s.sol) also omits setPauser. As deployed, pause() and unpause() revert 'Only pauser' for every caller including the owner, because no address satisfies msg.sender == pauser when pauser == address(0). The global Pauser contract (0x7c5A8EeF1d836450C019FB036453ac6eC97885a3) is wired to every other IPausable in the Phoenix ecosystem but is absent from the new minter's wiring. The _postVerify block (lines 208-236) asserts YS wiring and mint authority but has no assertion that pauser != address(0) or that the minter is registered with the global Pauser.
impact: If a mint exploit or abnormal behavior is discovered on the new minter after Phase 3 makes it the sole live mint path, the operator cannot pause it via the normal Pauser.pause(minter) governance path. The only recourse is per-token setStablecoinEnabled(token, false) — a slower, less composable manual mitigation requiring at least two owner-signed transactions. This is an operational gap for the lifetime of the new minter.
recommendation: Add two wiring steps in DeployNewPhusdMinter.s.sol after the IFlax.setMinter grant at line 178: (1) minter.setPauser(PAUSER_ADDRESS) and (2) IPauser(PAUSER_ADDRESS).register(address(minter)). Add a corresponding post-verify assertion: require(minter.pauser() == PAUSER_ADDRESS, 'Verify: pauser not set'). The global Pauser address is 0x7c5A8EeF1d836450C019FB036453ac6eC97885a3, confirmed in DeployMainnetNFTStaking.s.sol:55. setPauser must precede Pauser.register because register validates that pauser() already returns the Pauser's own address (established pattern, DeployMocks.s.sol:795-798).
